raw_html: [[Legendary Cursespewing]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Cursespewing]]:''' On [[Vorpal Strike|Vorpal Hit]]: Your enemy is cursed with a -4 morale penalty on [[attack roll]]s, [[saving throw]]s, and [[skill check]]s. This painful curse also causes the victim to take 6d6+6 damage every two seconds for a duration of twelve seconds. Additional vorpal strikes while the curse is active will extend the duration by another twelve seconds.
